definition.question: How intense is US-China technological decoupling and semiconductor export-control confrontation?
definition.low_end: Minimal export controls and open two-way technology trade with deeply integrated semiconductor supply chains.
definition.high_end: Comprehensive, near-total technological decoupling with blanket semiconductor export bans and fully severed supply chains.

readings.rationale: US controls are confirmed as major and repeatedly tightened (Oct 2022, Oct 2023, refinements Apr/Dec 2024) and ASML itself warns controls plus tech-sovereignty push may reshape supply chains, placing the dimension well above calm.
